title: How much of the roadside do shrubs actually cover?
summary: The rangeland model gives a percentage of ground covered by shrub crowns. We measured the projected union of the actual 3D crown meshes within an 86 m disk. The renderer now fills each eligible survey cell using measured crown area. Close shrubs use a higher-detail branching mesh.
measurement: On US 163, projected cover rose from 0.40% to 6.53% against a survey estimate of 6.82%. At US 191 it rose from 0.53% to 9.22% against 9.30%. This validates the total across the disk. US 163 still lacks shrubs at the near end of the photographed shoulder. Individual plant positions and forms are inferred.
credit: Photograph by Ken Lund, CC BY-SA 2.0. The crop and game comparison share that license. RAP and RCMAP supply the cover and height observations.
